views.name: invoice_item_with_track_and_album_artist
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ii.InvoiceLineId,
  ii.InvoiceId,
  inv.CustomerId,
  ii.TrackId,
  t.AlbumId,
  a.ArtistId,
  ii.UnitPrice,
  ii.Quantity,
  (ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS LineRevenue
FROM invoice_items AS ii
JOIN invoices AS inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
LEFT JOIN tracks AS t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
LEFT JOIN albums AS a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId
views.description: One row per invoice item, enriched with linked track, its album, and that album's artist id so revenue can be attributed to an artist and a customer.

views.name: artist_revenue_by_invoice_item
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ii.ArtistId AS ArtistId,
  SUM(ii.LineRevenue) AS ArtistTotalRevenue
FROM invoice_item_with_track_and_album_artist AS ii
GROUP BY ii.ArtistId
views.description: Total revenue attributed to each artist, computed by summing revenue of invoice items for tracks whose album belongs to that artist. Useful to determine the best-selling artist by invoice revenue.

views.name: customer_spend_by_artist
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  iiw.CustomerId AS CustomerId,
  iiw.ArtistId AS ArtistId,
  SUM(iiw.LineRevenue) AS AmountSpentOnArtist
FROM
  invoice_item_with_track_and_album_artist AS iiw
GROUP BY
  iiw.CustomerId,
  iiw.ArtistId
views.description: Customer-level spending broken down by artist: sum of invoice item revenue for each customer and artist pair. This lets queries ask how much a specific customer spent on a specific artist.

views.name: invoice_item_track_album_artist_sales
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ii.InvoiceLineId,
  ii.InvoiceId,
  inv.CustomerId,
  ii.TrackId,
  t.AlbumId,
  alb.ArtistId,
  art.Name AS ArtistName,
  ii.UnitPrice,
  ii.Quantity,
  (ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS Amount
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums alb ON t.AlbumId = alb.AlbumId
JOIN artists art ON alb.ArtistId = art.ArtistId
JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
WHERE t.AlbumId IS NOT NULL
views.description: Denormalized row-level sales contribution for each invoice item joined through track -> album -> artist. One row per invoice_items.InvoiceLineId with raw monetary contribution computed.

views.name: artist_total_sales_per_artist
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  a.ArtistId,
  a.Name AS ArtistName,
  SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS TotalSales
FROM artists a
JOIN albums al ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
JOIN tracks t ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN invoice_items ii ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
WHERE t.AlbumId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
views.description: Total sales (revenue) for each artist computed from invoice items linked to tracks whose tracks.AlbumId references albums.ArtistId. One row per ArtistId with raw total sales amount (no rounding).

views.name: customer_spending_by_artist
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  a.ArtistId AS ArtistId,
  a.Name AS ArtistName,
  c.CustomerId AS CustomerId,
  c.FirstName AS CustomerFirstName,
  c.LastName AS CustomerLastName,
  SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS AmountSpent
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
JOIN customers c ON inv.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
JOIN tracks t ON ii.TrackId = t.TrackId
JOIN albums al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId
JOIN artists a ON al.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
WHERE t.AlbumId IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name, c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
views.description: Per-customer total spending on each artist. One row per (ArtistId, CustomerId) with total AmountSpent computed from invoice_items -> tracks -> albums -> artists. Includes only customers with positive spending if filtered later.

views.name: customers_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  customers.CustomerId AS CustomerId,
  customers.Country AS Country,
  customers.FirstName AS FirstName,
  customers.LastName AS LastName,
  customers.SupportRepId AS SupportRepId
FROM customers
views.description: One row per customer with canonical customer identity and location/contact fields. Useful as the base cohort for customer-level grouping and joins to invoices or support reps.

views.name: invoices_row_level
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  InvoiceId,
  CustomerId,
  InvoiceDate,
  Total
FROM invoices
views.description: One row per invoice exposing invoice identity, customer linkage, invoice date and Total. Keeps NULL Totals visible so calling queries can exclude them.

views.name: country_level_total_sales
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  c.Country AS Country,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerId) AS customer_count,
  SUM(i.Total) AS country_total_sales
FROM customers c
JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE i.Total IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.Country
views.description: Per-country total sales computed by summing invoice Total for all invoices belonging to customers in that country. Each row is one country. NULL invoice Totals are ignored by summation at query time by filtering invoices.Total IS NOT NULL before aggregation (or the DB SUM will naturally skip NULLs).
